recoveryErrorChanged.message: Local records changed during inspection. No result from that read is shown. Refresh to inspect a new snapshot.

recoveryErrorSize.message: The inspection safety limit was reached. No result from that read is shown. Keep your original page open; no saved data was changed.

recoveryErrorInvalid.message: The inspection could not validate the local records. Keep your original page open; no saved data was changed.

recoveryErrorUnavailable.message: Read-only inspection is unavailable. Keep your original page open; no saved data was changed.

recoveryWarningInvalid.message: Some source data could not be validated.

recoveryWarningUnknown.message: Unrecognized fields are omitted from the investigation view and file.

recoveryWarningInvalidFields.message: Invalid fields are omitted. Some site records may be incomplete.

recoveryWarningPrivate.message: Private or unsupported fields are omitted. This is not a complete backup.

recoveryWarningSize.message: A safety limit prevents inspection or export of some data.

recoveryWarningChain.message: Deeper nested recovery copies are outside this inspection’s safety limit.

recoveryWarningRegistry.message: The workspace registry could not be validated. Workspace attribution may be uncertain.

recoveryWarningBundle.message: An expected workspace bundle was not found in this read. This does not prove deletion.

recoveryWarningUnverified.message: The source has not been verified. Recovery is not guaranteed.

recoveryWarningChecksumMissing.message: No usable checksum was available for verification.

recoveryWarningChecksumFailed.message: The recorded checksum did not match. The copy has not passed integrity checks.

recoveryWarningTime.message: No trustworthy record time is available.

recoveryWarningContentDiffers.message: Retained representations contain different content. Inspect each separately.

recoveryWarningCredentialUrl.message: URLs containing recognized credentials are omitted from the investigation view and file.

recoveryWarningGeneric.message: Some data could not be fully inspected or was omitted. This is not a complete recovery backup.

recoveryPreviewTruncated.message: Long title or URL text is shortened to the first 4,000 characters here. Investigation JSON keeps allowed field values in full.

recoveryWarningVersion.message: The stored configuration version is not recognized. Recovery compatibility is unknown.

recoveryWarningFormat.message: The stored record format is not recognized. Only allowed fields are shown for investigation.

spacesLegacyPaused.message: Workspace unavailable. Saving is paused while the older-tab conflict is reviewed.

storedURLExported.message: Settings exported with original URL spelling and layout relationships. Import this file only with a version that supports stored URL identity backups.

syncStoredURLPaused.message: Sync transfers are paused to preserve older URL spelling and layout relationships. Your saved copies and enabled preference are unchanged. Cloud preview is still available; use a current-version manual or Drive backup instead of Sync for these records.
